newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU to probe repurchase of Thomson's Lyonnais stake.
newsitem.headline: EU to probe repurchase of Thomson's Lyonnais stake.

text.p: The European Commission is to open a formal probe on Wednesday into the repurchase by the French state of Thomson SA's stake in Credit Lyonnais as part of a broader inquiry into a rescue plan for Thomson's consumer electronics unit.

Commission sources said on Tuesday that the Commission would have to assess whether the acquisition of Thomson's stake of about 20 percent was being made above market price, which could amount to disguised state subsidies.

They could not confirm a report in the French daily La Tribune which said on Tuesday that the French government has promised to pay 3.341 billion francs for the shareholding held by state-controlled Thomson and its defence electronics arm Thomson-CSF.

On Wednesday, the Commission is also due start a probe into the recapitalisation of Thomson Multimedia by some 10 billion francs as part of a French plan to help restore the company's long-term viability.
Both moves have been on the cards since the collapse of a decision to sell Thomson to Lagardere which in turn would have sold Thomson Multimedia to Daewoo Electronics.
The Commission usually only agrees to capital injections into state-controlled businesses if matched by a strict restructuring plan normally involving a cut or freeze in capacity.
